body:
I took  2.5 milliliters of Rum containing what was, unless my solution evaporated considerably, 10 mg of 5-MeO-DiPT, aka Foxy.
Having taken Foxy, and had quite a bit of fun, a few times previously, I decided that tonight was the night to mix it with another well-liked drug of mine: Ecstasy.
I don't do E much anymore. It fucks with my brain, and makes me feel like shit the day after. I never REALLY did it much to begin with, but I did enjoy a roll every now and again (ala every couple of weeks) for a few months.
Anyway, after I took the Foxy, I popped an E pill said to be very strong, and decided to chew it. A mistake, as I should've taken half, and half my Foxy dose, being unfamiliar with the combination.
Another mistake was having NOT EATEN for two days prior. Even though I knew Foxy causes nausea, I neglected to eat before dosing. Though this sounds oxymoronic, one must have a small amount of food in the stomach to settle it in case of mild nausea. Otherwise you vomit all over the Great American Diner and Pub.
And, my final mistake was going to a public place taking a combo I'd never taken before.
Thus, as our beer-battered onion rings arrived, I vomited all over the cultural center of my area, three times before I hit the bathroom. I must have looked hilarious.
After vomiting, I hauled ass OUT of the diner, while my friends waited for the check. I sat in my friend A's car and listened to music, talking myself down, using the MDMA to fight the Foxy's self-concious assault.
20 minutes later(they had to eat) we got, and me, A, and R came back to my house. Essentially, we hung out here, watched Broken Arrow, and listened to some Tool and Bill Hicks.
It would've been unremarkable besides that, accept while taking my dog out, I got my first full open eye visuals. Unlike normally, I didn't even have to consistently focus to keep the visuals there.
The world melted, and I laughed.
I'm on my downer now, and I must say Foxy smoothes out the E downer.
